params.body:
## Why

Second part of moving `resources/views/ownstock/` to the Tailwind/`ui-` vocabulary (first part: the modals and the XML confirmation). This one takes the four form partials that the Livewire vehicle sheet includes as plain form steps: prices, inspection dates, properties (options) and extras. Same field names, ids, `wire:model` props, classes that scripts read (`price_input`, `required`, `option_input`, `prices_error`, `ui-off`, `VATNeeded_select`, `VATPercentage_select`, `average_price_button`) and `onclick`/`onchange` handlers; only the layout markup changed. Independent of the first PR (no shared lines).

## Reachability

| View | Status |
|---|---|
| `_tabs/prices` | used: `livewire/vehicle-form` (`lw => true`), classic create/edit |
| `_tabs/_inspection_dates` | used: `livewire/vehicle-form` (`lw => true`), classic `_tabs/dates` |
| `_tabs/options` | used: `livewire/vehicle-form` (island behind `wire:ignore`), classic create/edit |
| `_tabs/extras` + `_tabs/extra_options` | used: `livewire/vehicle-form` (`lw => true`), classic create/edit |

The full table for the directory is in the first PR of this series.

## What per view

- `_tabs/prices`: `ui-form-grid ui-form-grid--3` for both rows; purchase, repairs and total stack in one cell (`ui-field-stack`), the sale price and trade price cells sit at the bottom (`self-end`) as `mt-auto` did; euro prefixes through `x-ui.affix`; the average-price button is `ui-button ui-button--sm`; the `prices_error` line keeps `d-flex`/`d-none` because `vehicle.js` toggles those. The two VAT selects drop `form-control` and `text-right` (the sheet already forced selects left-aligned).
- `_tabs/_inspection_dates`: three `ui-field`s in a `ui-form-grid--3`; datepickers unchanged.
- `_tabs/options`: the environment group and the generic groups render in `ui-form-grid--4`; units (mg/km, g CO2/km, pk, kwh, %) through `x-ui.affix`; checkbox rows keep `ui-own-check` in a Tailwind grid. The duplicate `id` on the old unit spans (same id as the input) is gone.
- `_tabs/extras` + `extra_options`: `ui-form-grid--3`, the notice spanning the row; the export-only extra checkboxes now use the same `ui-own-check` row as the properties tab.
- `refresh.css`: adds `ui-form-grid--3`, `ui-form-grid--4`, `ui-field-stack`, `ui-button--sm`; the price cap (`max-width: 220px`) also matches `.ui-affix:has(.price_input)`; `.ui-edit select:not([multiple])` no longer overrides the padding of `ui-input` selects (the chevron sat under the value); removes the `p.align-middle` and `.ui-own-check .form-check` rules whose markup is gone.

## Unused candidates

See the first PR. Nothing new here.

## Screenshots

`tw-ownstock-{before,after}-{prices,dates,options,extras}-{1280,390}.png` in the session scratchpad (test kernel + Playwright, fixture admin, Livewire sheet).

## Checked

- `php artisan view:cache` + `php -l` on the compiled touched views
- `php artisan test --filter='SmokeTest|CompiledViewsTest|StylesheetSyntaxTest|UiApiUsageTest|ClassReferencesResolveTest|VehicleForm|Vehicle'`: green (local MySQL `forge_test`)
- `npm run build`
